We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We must produce JSON tree: root molecule, then reaction nodes each with template_id, children being precursor molecules (type mol). The route must be linear? At least 5 reactions, using those templates in that order. So we need to apply each template sequentially retrosynthetically, i.e., starting from target, apply template 29646 to get precursors, then apply 1914389 to each appropriate precursor, etc., until we have final building blocks.

We have attempted applying template 29646 to target, got three possible outcomes (three sets of products). The result was a tuple of three strings? Actually result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

So three possible product sets each containing one molecule (the precursor). Choose one that can be further processed by template 1914389. The template 1914389 seems to be a protection/deprotection? The earlier attempts: applying 1914389 to a molecule with a silyl protecting group gave two products: a protected fragment and an ester? Actually result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So it splits into two fragments: one is the core with silyl group, the other is some side chain (maybe a protecting group). So we need to follow the order: after 29646, we apply 1914389 to the product(s). Then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We need to ensure each step yields precursors that can be further processed.

Let's pick the first outcome from 29646: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C". This has a silyl group and a side chain with carboxylic acid. Applying 1914389 gave three possible outcomes earlier? Actually we applied 1914389 to that molecule and got result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So it splits into two fragments: a core with silyl and an acetyl group (CC=O) maybe, and a side fragment "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". Good.

Now next template 1914390 should be applied to one of those fragments (likely the side fragment). We attempted applying 1914390 to that side fragment but got no result (empty). So maybe we need to apply 1914390 to the core fragment? Let's try applying 1914390 to "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C".
